rationale: gradient clipping max_norm=1.0 on top of iter-16 wd=1e-3 KEEP. Different regularization mechanism: caps per-step update magnitude.
advice_for_others: NEAR-FLAT DISCARD: hr=0.5815 vs iter-16 0.5833 (-0.18pp). Gradient norm in this regime (AdamW + MSE) already typically <1.0 so clipping rarely activates. Not harmful but no win. Lesson: do not use grad_clip on AdamW small-residual-net regimes; it is most useful when gradients can spike (RNN/transformer).
